controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Schenk and McKinnon (2024) controlled mosaic. Original 100 m grid delivered at about 197 m per equatorial texel. Source resolution and photographed shadows vary; globe Shadows add approximate lighting. Gray grid marks source no-data.
controls.summary: Images are aligned to a common surface model, but source detail varies. Photographed shadows remain; the grid marks gaps.
controls.title: Schenk–McKinnon mosaic

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows height above the reference ellipsoid with semi-axes 256.2 × 251.4 × 248.6 km. Colors saturate below −1 and above +1 km. Brightness shows relief under fixed northwest light, without height exaggeration. Gray grid marks missing model values. The 200 m grid contains stereogrammetric and photogrammetric terrain estimates; effective detail varies. This Schenk terrain grid and the corrected JPL v2 shape use different control solutions; local registration differences may remain.
controls.summary: Height relative to the source ellipsoid, clipped at ±1 km. Gray grid: missing stereo and shading data.
controls.title: Stereo and shading terrain model

controls.label: Shape
controls.description: Neutral grid over a simplified source shape, without photographic texture or height exaggeration. Source model detail and accuracy vary. Corrected JPL v2 SPC model; the original v1 solution is excluded.
controls.title: JPL v2 SPC shape model

controls.label: Ice absorption
controls.description: Water-ice absorption relative to a native 1.82–2.20 µm continuum. Six calibrated Cassini VIMS observations cover selected regions; gray grid marks unsupported areas. Strength also varies with viewing geometry and grain size. Archive noise filtering is retained; no photometric correction is applied. This is not ice percentage.
controls.summary: Near-2.02 µm water-ice absorption in partial Cassini coverage. Gray grid marks gaps. Viewing angle, grain size and archive filtering affect the uncorrected values; these are not ice percentages.
controls.title: Partial Cassini VIMS water-ice signature

controls.label: Infrared ratio
controls.description: Median reflectance in three channels near 3.1 µm divided by the near-1.66 µm channel. This samples an ice-sensitive infrared feature in six calibrated Cassini observations. Illumination, grain size and noise affect the ratio; it is not a crystallinity percentage or a temperature map. Archive filtering remains; no photometric correction. Gray grid marks unsupported areas.
controls.summary: A near-3.1/1.66 µm ice-sensitive ratio with partial Cassini coverage. Viewing angle, grain size and archive filtering affect the uncorrected values. Gray grid marks gaps; this does not measure temperature or crystallinity.
controls.title: Partial Cassini VIMS spectral ratio
